integrity: Analytical identity and all-dimensional Schur-complement proof supplied; finite exact and numerical checks supplement, not replace the proof. Publication priority remains subject to external verification.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-dimensional rank-one SPD split and fixed time steps only. Euclidean norm amplification does not imply spectral instability or divergence of fixed-step iterates. No claim for general nonsymmetric/indefinite splits, higher-rank increments, floating-point solves, or nonlinear PDE discretizations.
title: An arithmetic–harmonic gap gives the exact Euclidean contractivity horizon of rank-one IMEX Euler
